verification.scope: Artifact integrity, exact operation replay, stable identities, declared whole-image gates and strict geometry; physical decisions remain assistant visual review.

fixed_issues: Candidate exports now require exact relative TXT paths and exact proposal bytes, not filename stems.
Portable check compares stored verification to replay and HTML to one canonical renderer.
Typed hold-reason/field lists prevent verified metadata from breaking the viewer; identity/count/boolean types tightened.
Empty filters clear stale row identity/tokens; image-load guards avoid stale selection/render races; label whitespace is parsed consistently.
Five case PNGs are bound to diagnostic manifest identity, case paths and SHA256, retained as separate files, and embedded for srcdoc/standalone rendering.
independent_code_review.portable_verification: Passed with Python -S from /tmp using the packaged review.py

ui_fallback.mode: Node VM with minimal DOM adapters and real @napi-rs/canvas image decoding/drawing; not browser/CSS rendering

independent_code_review.browser_limitation: Installed Chromium wrapper has no executable; Playwright cache has no browser. No installation or remote session used.
independent_code_review.trust_boundary: Internal checks detect inconsistent artifacts. Authenticity still depends on the trusted published archive/manifest hashes; coordinated rewriting is not human visual approval.
